Card Q&A.a: No, you don't gain 1 memory. The effect reads "By..." Therefore, the rest of the effect won't activate if you don't trash a card in your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't trash 1 card in my hand, do I gain 1 memory from this card's [When Attacking] effect when [Eiji Nagasumi] is still in this Digimon's digivolution cards?

Effect: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞. If [Eiji Nagasumi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play a card with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait, gain 1 memory.
